title: Governed redispatch after WORK_ITEM_UNBLOCKED — READY with exact unblock-event provenance + canonically-terminal bound predecessors becomes eligible for ONE new mission attempt
description: READY+terminal-bound items could never be redispatched autonomously (review=INTERVENTION, launchable required no bound mission). REOPENABLE now requires proveCanonicalUnblockProvenance (one authority shared by review + dispatch boundary): the CURRENT READY must come from an authentic WORK_ITEM_UNBLOCKED — exact mint shape (BLOCKED->READY, actor operator:*), LAST status event, derived-prior honestly BLOCKED, and an earlier BLOCKED-producing event referencing the LATEST bound mission (SYNCED metadata.mission_id / BLOCKED metadata.mission_paused). REWORK/ROLLED_BACK/malformed/mis-ordered/superseded unblocks -> INTERVENTION; fresh READY stays ACTIVE; derived-status validator unweakened. proveDispatchAuthority re-proves AT the openWorkItem crossing: same unblock provenance + EVERY WOB attempt canonically terminal (derived status + assertCanonicalMissionLifecycle; live earlier attempt = operatingFail) + latest bound lifecycle; WAL/objective/budget strict as before. Tests 12/12: valid unblock->1 attempt; REWORK/ROLLED_BACK READY not reopenable; malformed+superseded unblock fail closed; beforeOpen drift -> zero attempts; REAL scheduler admission (wakeup.tick->claimable->claim; forged binding denied; revoked->POLICY_NOT_EFFECTIVE); forged lifecycle/WOB; dup tick+restart=1; mission-cap; A+B cross-mission consume. 162 regression pass; baseline f4 R5.1-crash identical on BASE.
